description: This PHP class defines the AssignTemplateVariable node used within the Twig templating engine to assign a variable to a template's context, with support for global scope assignment.

classes.name: AssignTemplateVariable
classes.description: Represents an assignment of a variable within a Twig template, either locally or globally.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the node with a TemplateVariable and whether the variable should be global.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to perform the variable assignment in the compiled template.
